prompt.image: warm rice-paper scroll field with deep slate end caps top and bottom, one continuous black ink line running horizontally and still drawing itself, empty hand-drawn rounded boxes waiting to be filled, a small vermilion seal in the corner, soft even paper light, no text. Palette bg:#efe6d2, surface:#f8f1e2, paper:#1c1c1c, accent:#2f4f6f, warning:#b23a2e, stamp:#c0392b. Type NotoSansSC 900/Geist/Geist Mono. Motifs: growing ink line, empty outline box, scroll end caps, vermilion seal, paper fibre. Composition: leave deliberate negative space for a headline; no readable text, no logos, no letters.
prompt.video: 逐层剥离: 成品 → 拆层 → 逐层证据 → 归位 → 落版. Motion: lateral unroll, line draw, box fill, seal press. Transition: 描线吸附. Captions: 页边注. Sound: 纸张音. Hook pattern: 我以前靠 [旧方法] 管理 [对象]。. Avoid the reference film's exact copy, shot order, durations, transition combination, caption animation, motifs and SFX arrangement.
prompt.cover: 3:4 poster, vertical rice-paper scroll with slate caps, a single ink line drawn down the middle, two empty outline boxes, one vermilion seal near the bottom, big calm empty area up top, no readable text. Hook: 自白. Hero motif: growing ink line. Brand block at bottom; keep key text in the top 75% and the right 120px clear. Render all text in HTML/SVG, not in the generated image.
prompt.negative: reference film's exact copy, shot order, durations, light sweep, halftone wipe, flash white, center keyword sticker, metal title slam, riser/whoosh/shimmer, gibberish Chinese text, logos, watermarks
